spec.description: The newest product of one type from one location, with its text. Where that location has issued nothing of that type, the service answers HTTP 500 ("Unexpected Problem"), not 404, and the call raises `ApiError`: `products.list_products_by_type_and_location` tells the two apart, answering an empty `@graph`.

type_id.description: Three-letter product type, such as `AFD`. `products.list_product_types` names every code.

location_id.description: Issuance location, such as `SEW` for Seattle. `products.list_locations` names every id; `products.list_locations_for_type` narrows them to one type.

notes: Measured 2026-10-11: `/products/types/CLI/locations/OKX/latest` answers 500 with an `UnexpectedProblem` problem detail, while `/products/types/CLI/locations/OKX` answers 200 with an empty `@graph`. The same holds for RR5/OKX, CLI/LWX and RR5/LWX. The core does not turn that 500 into anything else: a real server fault answers the same status and body, so it cannot tell the two apart either.
